Proud to share I’ve secured $5 MILLION in federal funding to help deliver a long-term solution to our community’s bridge and transportation challenges—improving public safety, strengthening emergency access, and reducing heavy commercial traffic through residential neighborhoods.

Working alongside Township leaders, we helped reopen the bridge earlier this year. But restoring access was only the first step. Our goal has always been a lasting solution.
